question: The Bonalu festival in Hyderabad is traditionally linked to the outbreak of which disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plague**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Bonalu festival is a **Hindu festival celebrated in Telangana, primarily in Hyderabad and Secunderabad**, dedicated to Goddess Mahakali.
 
• The festival originated as a **thanksgiving ritual to the Goddess** after the region experienced an outbreak of the plague in the 19th century.
 
• According to belief, the locals prayed to the Goddess Mahakali to protect them from the plague, and the festival was established to honor her intervention.
 
• The name "Bonalu" is derived from "Bhojanalu," which means meals or offerings. Devotees prepare special meals and offer them to the Goddess as a symbol of gratitude.
 
• The festival also features **processions, traditional dances, and rituals**, with women carrying decorated pots of offerings on their heads as part of the celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cholera:**

 
 
• Cholera is an acute diarrheal illness caused by infection of the intestine with the bacterium *Vibrio cholerae*.
 
• It spreads through contaminated water or food and can lead to severe dehydration and death if untreated.
 
• In India, cholera outbreaks were common in earlier centuries, but improved sanitation and public health interventions have reduced its prevalence.
 
 
 
• **Malaria:**
 
 
• Malaria is a mosquito-borne disease caused by *Plasmodium* parasites, transmitted through the bites of infected female *Anopheles* mosquitoes.
 
• It leads to symptoms like fever, chills, and flu-like illness and can cause severe complications if untreated.
 
• Although malaria has been a major health concern in India, its connection to the Bonalu festival is not established.
 
 
 
• **Smallpox:**
 
 
• Smallpox is a contagious disease caused by the *Variola virus*, known for its characteristic pustular rash and fever.
 
• It was eradicated globally by 1980 through extensive vaccination campaigns, becoming the first disease to be eradicated.
 
• While smallpox has caused significant suffering in the past, it is unrelated to the origins of the Bonalu festival.
 
 
 
• **Bonalu Festival:**
 
 
• The festival typically takes place during the **Ashada Masam** (July-August) in the Telugu calendar.
 
• Bonalu is celebrated at various temples dedicated to the Goddess, including the **Simhavahini Mahakali Temple** and the **Ujjaini Mahakali Temple** in Secunderabad.
 
• The festival is a vibrant expression of devotion, involving rituals like animal sacrifices, drumming, and folk performances.
